d:
Cyclone Arnab : chakravati tuphan arnab ka asar bihar ke kaee jilon men dekhne ko mila hai. tej hava aur barish ke karan kheton men lagi dhan ki phasal ko bhari nuksan pahuncha hai. phasal barbad hone se dhan ke utpadan men 15 se 20 phisdi tak kami aane ka anuman jataya ja raha hai.
Vahin, dalhan aur tilhan samet dusri phaslon ki buaaee men bhi deri hone ki aashanka hai. tuphan ki mar se kisanon ki chinta barh gaee hai. aakhir bihar men kheti aur kisanon par kitna parega iska asar? dekhie puri riporta.
